nodes.name: Prepare Nexus Input
nodes.notes: For Manual Trigger runs, fill manualInput in this node. Webhook/Form/parent workflows can provide task, project_key, issue_number, and repo_dir on the incoming item instead.

nodes.name: Create Nexus Run
nodes.notes: Creates the durable Nexus run that n8n will advance.

nodes.name: 01 Start research
nodes.notes: Gather context about the topic. Identify: key insight or hook, audience, ideal format (single tweet vs thread), and 2–4 relevant hashtags. X audience skews technical/professional. Punchy, opinionated content performs better.

nodes.name: Complete research
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 02 Start write
nodes.notes: Write the X post or thread based on the research brief. Single tweet: max 280 chars, punchy, one clear idea. Thread: 3–8 tweets, each ≤280 chars. Number them (1/ 2/ etc.). Tone: direct, confident, conversational. No corporate speak. Hashtags: max 2–3, at the end of the last tweet only.

nodes.name: Complete write
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 03 Start review
nodes.notes: Review the post for: character limits (each tweet ≤280 chars), tone (punchy, not corporate), hashtag count (≤3), no unverified claims, no policy violations. Approve or request specific changes.

nodes.name: Complete review
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: Route route_review
nodes.notes: Evaluates Nexus route rules and writes next_step.

nodes.name: 05 Start publish
nodes.notes: Publish the approved post or thread to X. First run a dry_run to validate character limits and credentials. For threads: set metadata.thread_mode=True. Post the result (tweet URL or first tweet URL) as a comment.

nodes.name: Approval Gate publish
nodes.notes: Connect this node to an n8n approval/wait mechanism if the gate must pause.

nodes.name: Complete publish
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 06 Start close_loop
nodes.notes: Write a short summary of the published post. Close the issue with label social:published.

nodes.name: Complete close_loop
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: Switch route_review
nodes.notes: Routes to the Nexus step selected by the preceding Code node.
